entities.summary: Leo Magdugo Dalmao, CMF is a Filipino bishop of the Roman Catholic Church, currently serving as the bishop-prelate of the Prelature of Isabela in Basilan, Philippines. He was appointed as bishop by Pope Francis on March 25, 2019.
